configurations.A0: single strongest view (MiniLM sim text / token jaccard code), val/inner-tuned threshold
configurations.A2: A1 + Platt calibration on val / inner-OOF
configurations.A3: A1 + adaptive routing to heavy S2 (no calibration, unconstrained OP cap 1.0)
configurations.A4: A1 + budget-only escalation (uncertainty band by |p-0.5|, cap-driven)
configurations.A5: A2 + routing (calibrated) with unconstrained operating point
configurations.A6: full framework = A5 + budget-capped operating point (text 0.70 / code 0.45)
configurations.scope_note: identifier-renaming augmentation is attack-hardening, excluded here; it is isolated in the phase-5 robustness artifacts.
